question.text:
Statement I: By doping silicon semiconductors with pentavalent material, the electrons density increases.

Statement II: The n-type of semiconductor has a net negative charge.

In the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
Statement I is false but Statement II is true.
Both Statement I and Statement II are true.

solution.text: Pentavalent material has excess free <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mo>-</mo></msup></math> because we mix the impurities like phosphorus and arsenic having five electrons in the outermost shell. So <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mo>-</mo></msup></math>density increases, but overall semiconductor is neutral. So we can say that Statement I is true but, Statement II is false.
